blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. In this lesson, "Software and Apps", you learn the simple English you need every day at work.

You use this English when you talk to the help desk or when you join an online meeting. Today you learn five useful words and you practise them in short, natural sentences.

Go slowly — one step at a time. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow. You can do it!

items.q: Which offices does IT support?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many useful words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words."

items.q: When do you use this English?
options: Only when you go on holiday
When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting
Only when you write a book
items.why: "You use this English when you talk to the help desk or when you join an online meeting."

items.q: The text says "Go slowly — one step at a time." This suggests that…
options: the lesson is only for experts
it is fine to learn a little at a time
items.why: Inferência: o tom é calmo e encorajador — aprender aos poucos está tudo bem.

items.q: "Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow." The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: simple daily care helps the whole company
good habits are a waste of time
items.why: Inferência: a frase valoriza pequenos hábitos que evitam problemas maiores.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James mostrando os aplicativos a um novo usuário. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! Let me show you the main apps we use here at Czarnikow. Don't worry, they are all easy.

First, this app is for messages. We use it every day to talk to the team. It is working well today, so you can try it now.

This program opens your files. Your reports are here too. You can find one file, open it, and read it. All the reports are ready for you to check.

This tool is on the shared drive. Many people use these tools, so please save your work often.

If something looks strange, call IT support. Our team is small, but very responsive. Sophie calls them whenever she has a problem, and they help fast.

That's all for today. Take it slowly, one step at a time. Small habits help a lot. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the first app for?
items.why: "First, this app is for messages."

items.q: Where is the tool?
items.why: "This tool is on the shared drive."

items.q: What should you do if something looks strange?
items.why: "If something looks strange, call IT support."

items.q: James says the apps are "all easy." This suggests that…
options: the apps are only for experts
the new user should not feel worried
the user will never use them
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "Don't worry" e "they are all easy" para tranquilizar o novo usuário.

items.q: Why does James say "please save your work often"?
options: Because many people use the tools too
Because he wants to close the app
items.why: Inferência: como muitas pessoas usam a mesma ferramenta compartilhada, salvar com frequência protege o trabalho.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The app is working well today." An app is…
options: an application on your phone or computer
items.why: App = aplicativo, um programa no celular ou computador.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ is ready for you to check. Just open it and read."
items.why: File = arquivo: você abre e lê.

items.q: "We restart the report every evening." A report is…
items.why: Report = relatório, um documento com informações.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There's a new ___ on the help desk. You install it and then you can use it."
items.why: Program = programa: você instala e usa.

items.q: "The tool is on the shared drive." A tool is…
options: something you use to do a job
items.why: Tool = ferramenta: algo que você usa para fazer um trabalho.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de trabalho com apps e computadores. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please log in with your name and password." To log in means to…
items.why: Log in = entrar na conta com nome e senha.

items.q: "IT will set up your new computer today." To set up means to…
options: prepare it so it is ready to use
items.why: Set up = preparar/configurar para ficar pronto para usar.

items.q: "Remember to back up your files every week." To back up means to…
items.why: Back up = fazer uma cópia de segurança.

items.q: "Before you go home, please shut down the computer." To shut down means to…
items.why: Shut down = desligar o computador.

items.q: "Let's log out at the end of the day." To log out means to…
items.why: Log out = sair da conta.
